extracted.name: Creamy Hot Chocolate
extracted.description: This hot chocolate with sweetened condensed milk, cocoa, and vanilla is a comforting beverage to have on hand to warm up with on cold winter days.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) can EAGLE BRAND® Sweetened Condensed Milk
instruction_lines: Combine sweetened condensed milk, cocoa, vanilla, and salt in a large saucepan over medium heat; mix well. Slowly stir in hot water; cook until heated through, stirring occasionally. Do not boil. Top with marshmallows. Store covered in the refrigerator.
